owner_instruction: Analyze concrete failed cases, recommend modifications, then run the experiments
scientific_status: Exploratory development on the already observed original validation split; not a fresh final test or preregistration of old failures
gradient_probe_selection: From the frozen sixteen TRAIN diagnostic groups, smallest IDs within stratum:3one-edge,3one-injection-multi-edge,2multi-injection; no derivative/outcome selection
case_rng: Separate SHA256(seed,phase,epoch,group) Torch/NumPy/Python streams; same stream keys across arms; DGL full neighbors; no bitwise cross-device claim

training_loss.alignment: mean over ALL injected nodes of .1*D*strict(D>frozen TRAIN q90), same original reference
training_loss.protected_update: Per existing parameter block, project opposing alignment component off the smooth attack gradient and cap its norm to attack-gradient norm; zero attack gradient suppresses alignment; original Adam/weight-decay retained; no monotonic Adam guarantee

outer_policies.smooth_threshold: ON epochs2..8, unprotected original node-q90 contribution
outer_policies.smooth_agent: External LLM sees only prior completed TRAIN state and decides one outer ON/OFF each epoch2..8; ON uses same block protection
outer_policies.smooth_random: Outcome-independent permutation of same-seed agent actually applied ON flags among epochs2..8, not equal node-level activation/dose

agent_state: TRAIN-only aggregate target margins, hinge/smooth losses, D/outside fraction, eight-group UNPROTECTED gradient diagnostics and previous actual actions; no validation results or raw IDs
agent_failure: Wait at most20seconds; invalid/timeout/budget failures use registered protected-gradient-availability fallback; all late calls still charged but not retroactively applied
filter: Frozen robust descriptor score fit/calibrated on original TRAIN80/20 with no fraud labels; strict99th percentile; isolate flagged nodes identically without origin IDs; descriptors not optimized alignment moments but not statistically independent

evaluation.primary: Occurrence-weighted GCN MR after the fixed isolation filter at terminal epoch8, all128 registered validation groups/1091occurrences
secondary: all128 matched clean-original and filtered-original group predictions and clean-to-attack new-error/recovery counts
same fixed original-validation64benign+64fraud clean utility before/after filter
evaluation.pairing: Only new same-harness arms/seed pairs; old selected scores are descriptive motivation, not paired controls
evaluation.winner: No forced winner or resource expansion; compare agent to protected-rule and matched-random descriptively across3seeds; neural-policy and adaptive/full GAGA test remain incomplete

limitations: The heuristic filter is an unoptimized proxy, not a claim of a strong production defense or adaptive attack success.
Only two old seed3 checkpoints/16TRAIN groups motivated gradient measurements; no causal claim about entire old training.
Global epoch scheduling cannot claim per-node or per-case LLM routing superiority.
No trained neural action-policy comparator is included in this bounded feasibility phase; no general LLM-superiority claim.
Validation examples motivate the method; they are never agent examples or query inputs.
